name: Influenza, COVID-19, RSV, and Other Respiratory Virus Laboratory Surveillance

columns.name: mmwr_week
columns.description: A weekly counting system within a calendar year standardized by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

columns.name: week
columns.description: The calendar week standardized by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

columns.name: week_start
columns.description: Beginning date of the MMWR week

columns.name: week_end
columns.description: Ending date of the MMWR week

columns.name: season
columns.description: Annually recurring reporting period for which estimates are calculated, beginning during MMWR week 40 and ending with week 39 of the following year

columns.name: pathogen
columns.description: The respiratory virus corresponding to laboratory testing

columns.name: lab_tot_tested
columns.description: Total number of specimens tested for the specified pathogen as reported by participating laboratories

columns.name: lab_tot_positive
columns.description: Total number of specimens that were positive for the specified pathogen as reported by participating laboratories

columns.name: lab_pct_positive
columns.description: Percentage of specimens that were positive for the specified pathogen as reported by participating laboratories

columns.name: lab_tot_tested_cumulative
columns.description: Total number of specimens tested for the specified pathogen in the specified season, which goes from week 40 of each year to week 39 of the following year

columns.name: lab_tot_positive_cumulative
columns.description: Total number of specimens that were positive for the specified pathogen in the specified season, which goes from week 40 of each year to week 39 of the following year

columns.name: lab_pct_positive_cumulative
columns.description: Percentage of specimens that were positive for the specified pathogen in the specified season, which goes from week 40 of each year to week 39 of the following year

columns.name: current_week_ending
columns.description: Ending date of the MMWR week for the current season

columns.name: row_id
columns.description: A unique ID for the row
